turns.source_text: The arcade scoreboard has challenged me personally.
turns.v6_text: The arcade scoreboard has challenged me personally.
turns.v7_text: The arcade scoreboard has challenged me personally.

turns.speaker: MIMI
turns.source_text: It displayed a number.
turns.v6_text: It displayed a number.
turns.v7_text: It displayed a number.

turns.speaker: DILO
turns.source_text: In a tone.
turns.v6_text: In a tone.
turns.v7_text: In a tone.

turns.speaker: LULI
turns.source_text: Solve the wristband case before you start a feud with a scoreboard.
turns.v6_text: Solve the wristband case before you start a feud with a scoreboard.
turns.v7_text: I've got the wristband file. Can you bear to leave your rival unsupervised?

turns.speaker: DILO
turns.source_text: Feud postponed.
turns.v6_text: Feud postponed.
turns.v7_text: For the case. Tell it I haven't surrendered.

turns.speaker: ALIO
turns.source_text: I have paused my dramatic theory.
turns.v6_text: I have paused my dramatic theory.
turns.v7_text: I have paused my dramatic theory.

turns.speaker: LULI
turns.source_text: Voluntarily?
turns.v6_text: Voluntarily?
turns.v7_text: Voluntarily?

turns.speaker: ALIO
turns.source_text: The muddy evidence requested a word.
turns.v6_text: The muddy evidence requested a word.
turns.v7_text: Yes. I thought I'd see what the mud had to say first.

turns.speaker: LULI
turns.source_text: Give it the floor.
turns.v6_text: Give it the floor.
turns.v7_text: Then I'll be quiet too.

turns.speaker: MIMI
turns.source_text: The arrow shouts. The mud explains.
turns.v6_text: I will wait here while you check.
turns.v7_text: Both of you? I should photograph this.

turns.speaker: ALIO
turns.source_text: Painful. But memorable.
turns.v6_text: Good. I would like my next theory to have feet.
turns.v7_text: Footprints first. My good behaviour can wait for the family album.

turns.speaker: NINI
turns.source_text: This parcel has met more helpful people than it can remember.
turns.v6_text: This parcel has met more helpful people than it can remember.
turns.v7_text: This parcel has met a lot of people. Has anyone asked where it wants to go?

turns.speaker: MIMI
turns.source_text: Then we help it in a less creative order.
turns.v6_text: Then we help it in a less creative order.
turns.v7_text: Let's find out before somebody helpfully moves it again.

turns.speaker: DILO
turns.source_text: Revolutionary idea: one label, one destination.
turns.v6_text: Revolutionary idea: one label, one destination.
turns.v7_text: I'll guard it. No unauthorised helping.

turns.speaker: ALIO
turns.source_text: And possibly biscuits.
turns.v6_text: And possibly biscuits.
turns.v7_text: What about morale biscuits?

turns.speaker: MIMI
turns.source_text: Please stop investigating lunch.
turns.v6_text: We can investigate lunch after the handoff. I saved you a place.
turns.v7_text: For us. The parcel has had quite enough people trying to improve its day.

turns.speaker: NINI
turns.source_text: Empty does not always mean useless.
turns.v6_text: Empty does not always mean useless.
turns.v7_text: Empty rooms. We've been looking at everyone except nobody.

turns.speaker: DILO
turns.source_text: My bedroom would like that entered into evidence.
turns.v6_text: My bedroom would like that entered into evidence.
turns.v7_text: Nobody has been very quiet.

turns.speaker: LULI
turns.source_text: Your bedroom is not an admissible precedent.
turns.v6_text: Your bedroom is not an admissible precedent.
turns.v7_text: Already my favourite witness.

turns.speaker: MIMI
turns.source_text: Fortunately.
turns.v6_text: Fortunately.
turns.v7_text: I'm telling your brothers you said that.

turns.speaker: BIBI
turns.source_text: Old systems sometimes hide meaning in what they do not fill.
turns.v6_text: Old systems sometimes hide meaning in what they do not fill.
turns.v7_text: A historic moment. Detective, pull your maps closer before they recover.

turns.speaker: BIBI
turns.source_text: Clean hands. Flat map. No heroic folding.
turns.v6_text: Clean hands. Flat map. No heroic folding.
turns.v7_text: Clean hands. Flat map. No heroic folding.

turns.speaker: ALIO
turns.source_text: What about a small heroic point?
turns.v6_text: What about a small heroic point?
turns.v7_text: What about a small heroic point?

turns.speaker: BIBI
turns.source_text: One finger. A landmark. I can allow it.
turns.v6_text: One finger. A landmark. I can allow it.
turns.v7_text: One finger. A landmark. I can allow it.

turns.speaker: DILO
turns.source_text: We solved a parcel just to earn permission for one finger.
turns.v6_text: We solved a parcel just to earn permission for one finger.
turns.v7_text: We solved a parcel just to earn permission for one finger.

turns.speaker: BIBI
turns.source_text: A worthy investment.
turns.v6_text: A worthy investment.
turns.v7_text: A worthy investment.

turns.speaker: ALIO
turns.source_text: I have put my tunnel theory on a separate card.
turns.v6_text: I have put my tunnel theory on a separate card.
turns.v7_text: I have put my tunnel proposal on a separate card.

turns.speaker: LULI
turns.source_text: How much evidence is on the card?
turns.v6_text: How much evidence is on the card?
turns.v7_text: How much evidence is on the card?

turns.speaker: ALIO
turns.source_text: At present? Decorative confidence.
turns.v6_text: At present? Decorative confidence.
turns.v7_text: At present? Decorative confidence.

turns.speaker: MIMI
turns.source_text: Better than the muddy arrows. At least your theory admits it is guessing.
turns.v6_text: Better than the muddy arrows. At least your theory admits it is guessing.
turns.v7_text: I'd like a card. Some of my very organised plans are mostly that.

turns.speaker: BIBI
turns.source_text: That would have saved my old squad several afternoons.
turns.v6_text: That would have saved my old squad several afternoons.
turns.v7_text: Make it two. I used to call mine 'experience'.

turns.speaker: MIMI
turns.source_text: Largest map in the book. Same rule as always: prove it.
turns.v6_text: Largest map in the book. Same rule as always: prove it.
turns.v7_text: That's a lot of map. I'll clear some space.

turns.speaker: NINI
turns.source_text: Take your time. We are not going anywhere.
turns.v6_text: Take your time. We are not going anywhere.
turns.v7_text: Take your time. We are not going anywhere.

turns.speaker: DILO
turns.source_text: I can be quiet for one map.
turns.v6_text: I can be quiet for one map.
turns.v7_text: I can be quiet for one map.

turns.speaker: LULI
turns.source_text: New evidence already.
turns.v6_text: New evidence already.
turns.v7_text: I've written that down. In pencil, to be fair.

turns.speaker: BIBI
turns.source_text: Make the call when you're ready.
turns.v6_text: Make the call when you're ready.
turns.v7_text: Make the call when you're ready.

turns.speaker: MIMI
turns.source_text: No new clue. Use what you earned.
turns.v6_text: Use what you earned.
turns.v7_text: Case Wall ready? Then the panel's yours.

turns.speaker: DILO
turns.source_text: Victory noise?
turns.v6_text: Victory noise?
turns.v7_text: And the victory noise is mine.

turns.speaker: LULI
turns.source_text: Pending evidence.
turns.v6_text: Pending evidence.
turns.v7_text: Keep it in your head until the door opens.

turns.speaker: NINI
turns.source_text: Very pending.
turns.v6_text: Very pending.
turns.v7_text: Mine's already getting a bit loud in there.

turns.speaker: BIBI
turns.source_text: Begin.
turns.v6_text: Begin.
turns.v7_text: Go on, Detective. We'll be right behind you.
